checks: Finds both files of a rule about reasoning tags, whose text quotes </think> throughout (#2409)

input.rule: Reasoning tags: a model reply may open with `<think>` and close the block with `</think>`; some replies use `<thinking>` and `</thinking>`. Every parser must treat text after the matching `</think>` as the answer, ignore a `</think>` that appears inside a code span, and never treat `</think>` inside the answer as the end of a block. The exact list of accepted closing tags (`</think>`, `</thinking>`, `</reasoning>`) is defined in @file:docs/reasoning-tags.md and the edge cases with a quoted `</think>` are in @file:libs/llm/think-tag.fixtures.json.

input.rule: When a function strips model reasoning (`<think>…</think>` or `<thinking>…</thinking>` blocks) before parsing JSON, it must balance the closing tag against the opening one, never cut at the first `</think>`. Follow the parsing contract in @file:docs/llm-output-contract.md and the examples in @file:libs/llm/structured-output-repair.spec.ts.
